INSERT INTO space_members (space_id, user_id, role, expires_at, sponsor_user_id)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3,
                   COALESCE($4, CASE WHEN $3 = 'guest' AND $6::float8 IS NOT NULL
                                     THEN now() + make_interval(secs => $6) END),
                   $5)
           ON CONFLICT (space_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
